s1.syndrome_frame: Acute inflammatory arthritis following intra-articular injection
salient_findings: Acute bilateral knee swelling and pain
Elevated synovial fluid white blood cell count
key_facts: Onset of pain 12 hours after injections
Peripheral white blood cell count of 12.8×10^3/mm³
Bilateral knee arthrocentesis with elevated synovial fluid white blood cell count
Negative gram stain and cultures in both knees

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute inflammatory arthritis following intra-articular injection
salient_findings: Acute bilateral knee swelling and pain
Elevated synovial fluid white blood cell count
key_facts: Onset of pain 12 hours after injections
Peripheral white blood cell count of 12.8×10^3/mm³
Bilateral knee arthrocentesis with elevated synovial fluid white blood cell count
Negative gram stain and cultures in both knees

differentials: Infectious arthritis due to atypical bacteria
per_call: Infectious arthritis due to atypical bacteria

shortlist.label: Septic arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated synovial fluid white blood cell count and negative gram stain

shortlist.label: Viscosupplementation-related inflammatory reaction
shortlist.why_kept: Onset of pain 12 hours after Synvisc injections

shortlist.label: Crystal-induced arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute inflammatory arthritis following intra-articular injection

shortlist.label: Gonococcal arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Acute bilateral knee swelling and pain

shortlist.label: Pseudogout
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated C-reactive protein level and erythrocyte sedimentation rate

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of acute bilateral knee swelling and pain started 12 hours after the Synvisc viscosupplementation injections, and the laboratory results show elevated inflammatory markers without evidence of infection, which is consistent with a viscosupplementation-related inflammatory reaction.

rejected.label: Septic arthritis
rejected.why: Negative gram stain and cultures in both knees make infection unlikely

rejected.label: Crystal-induced arthritis
rejected.why: No mention of crystal identification in the synovial fluid analysis

rejected.label: Gonococcal arthritis
rejected.why: No fever, chills, or malaise, and negative cultures, make gonococcal infection unlikely

rejected.label: Pseudogout
rejected.why: No mention of crystal identification in the synovial fluid analysis, and the timing of symptoms after injection is more suggestive of a reaction to the viscosupplementation
